verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface for operating or managing Jev. The natural-language questions in the Playground (e.g. "Does this message express urgency?") are the model's evaluation input, not commands that control the product. The first-party agent skill only gives an external coding agent (Claude Code, Codex) API context so it can write code that calls Jev, which is a host-platform/developer-side workaround and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
